methodology.parameters: No parameter tuning, no fund selection by backtest results, no leveraged products. These are two implementation variants of existing factors, not new independent factors.
methodology.validation: Register actual input hashes and code before evaluation. Use recurring-program review to replay costs, targets and independent bt under unchanged netSharpe>1,SPY and15%drawdown gates.
